content:
At BioRender, we’re on a mission to accelerate the world’s ability to learn, discover, and communicate science — transforming how knowledge is shared and making science open, collaborative, and easily understandable by all.

We’re shaping the future of science communication and are looking for talented individuals to help bring this vision to life! 🚀

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Growth team and help drive adoption and engagement across BioRender's expanding product portfolio.

Growth is a highly cross-functional team that works across much of the BioRender product, focused on the company's highest-priority growth opportunities. Right now, that means helping more scientists discover and adopt our new AI and Graphing capabilities, improving the self-serve user experience, and finding new opportunities to drive activation, retention, and revenue.

In this role, you'll work closely with engineering, design, data science, and product leadership to identify growth opportunities, develop and test hypotheses, and turn insights into measurable product improvements. We're looking for someone who brings strong product judgment, is comfortable getting into the data themselves, and can independently drive initiatives from identifying the problem through execution and measurement.

What you'll do:

  • Identify and prioritize growth opportunities: Use product data, user research, and experimentation to uncover opportunities to improve activation, engagement, retention, and monetization across BioRender.
  • Drive adoption of new products: Develop and test strategies to help users discover and adopt BioRender's expanding capabilities, including AI-powered figure creation and scientific graphing.
  • Own growth experiments end to end: Form hypotheses, define success metrics, partner with engineering and design to launch experiments, analyze results, and make recommendations on what to ship, iterate on, or stop.
  • Improve the self-serve user journey: Identify friction in onboarding, product discovery, and conversion, and develop solutions that help users reach value faster and adopt more of BioRender.
  • Drive measurable business impact: Develop initiatives that improve product usage, self-serve revenue, and qualified lead generation for our enterprise business.
  • Partner across teams: Work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Data Science, Marketing, and other teams to align on priorities and deliver initiatives that support broader company goals.
  • Lead execution: Work directly with engineers and designers to define requirements, prioritize work, manage scope and trade-offs, and keep projects moving from concept to launch.
  • Help shape Growth's roadmap: Bring forward new ideas, size opportunities, and use data and product judgment to influence where the team invests its time and resources.

What you bring:

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including experience driving growth through product improvements, ideally in a SaaS or product-led business.
  • Proven track record of shipping product improvements that drove measurable impact on adoption, engagement, retention, conversion, or revenue.
  • Strong analytical skills and hands-on experience analyzing product data to understand user behavior, identify opportunities, and inform product decisions.
  • Experience designing, running, and evaluating A/B tests or other product experiments, including defining success metrics and making decisions based on results.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguous business or product problems, prioritize high-impact initiatives, and translate them into actionable plans.
  • Strong execution skills, with experience working directly with engineering teams to scope, prioritize, and ship product initiatives.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to build alignment across teams, navigate trade-offs, and influence decisions with data and sound judgment.
Nice to have:
  • Experience with AI-powered products, usage-based pricing, or credit-based monetization.
  • Background in life sciences or experience building products for scientists and researchers.



Why join us?

  • We are mission-driven: we work collaboratively towards our shared vision of improving scientific communication and accelerating scientific discovery. BioRender figures have appeared in more than 54,000 publications!
  • BioRender is loved by millions: We have a world-class NPS and a community of loyal fans and users in 200+ countries!
  • Our company is backed by top investors and accelerators like Y Combinator, and we are on a growth trajectory comparable to many top-performing SaaS companies
  • We’re remote-first with team members across Canada and the U.S., offering you the flexibility to work from anywhere.

BioRender is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. By submitting this application, you consent to the processing of your personal data by BioRender in accordance with GDPR and our Privacy Policy.
